title: Fix: Add mutex protection to StorageWriter.flush()
author: dev-alice
body:
# Fix: Add Mutex Protection to StorageWriter.flush()

## Related Issue
Closes #1 — Data loss on concurrent writes to shared storage

## Changes
- Added `ReentrantLock` to `StorageWriter.flush()` method
- Implemented `WriteBatch` queue with thread-safe ordering
- Added retry logic for write conflicts (3 retries, exponential backoff)
- Updated `StorageWriter` unit tests with concurrent write scenarios

## Test Results
- All existing tests pass ✓
- New concurrent write tests: 8/8 pass ✓
- Stress test (100 concurrent writers): 0 data loss ✓
- Performance impact: <2% throughput reduction on single-writer scenarios

## Review Status
- dev-bob: Approved with comments (suggest minor refactor)
- dev-carol: Requested changes (concerns about deadlock edge case)

## Checklist
- [x] Tests added/updated
- [x] Documentation updated
- [x] No breaking changes
- [ ] Security review needed for lock implementation

title: Performance: Implement lazy loading and chunked processing
author: dev-bob
body:
# Performance: Implement Lazy Loading and Chunked Processing

## Related Issue
Addresses #2 — Performance degradation with large datasets

## Changes
- Replaced `DataProcessor.load()` bulk loading with `DataStream` iterator
- Implemented cursor-based pagination for API queries
- Added configurable chunk size (default: 10,000 rows)
- Memory usage reduced from O(n) to O(chunk_size)

## Benchmark Results
| Dataset Size | Old Query Time | New Query Time | Old Memory | New Memory |
|-------------|---------------|---------------|-----------|------------|
| 100K        | 0.8s          | 0.9s          | 200MB     | 50MB       |
| 500K        | 12s           | 2.5s          | 1.2GB     | 50MB       |
| 1M          | 45s           | 5.2s          | 4.8GB     | 50MB       |
| 2M          | OOM           | 10.5s         | OOM       | 50MB       |

## Review Status
- dev-alice: Review in progress

## Breaking Changes
⚠️ `DataProcessor.load()` API signature changed — downstream consumers need update

## Checklist
- [x] Tests added/updated
- [x] Documentation updated
- [ ] Migration guide for API changes needed
- [ ] Performance regression tests needed
